challenge: NodeKit reference records could close inside one scoring workflow, but NodeRoom and other applications had no small public contract that bound an exact record-to-record handoff to the current Caseflow and repository revision without inventing another store or verdict authority.
observedFailure: A consumer could display a rule, receipt, or feed projection while the relationship to the exact upstream digest, candidate commit, stage state, or authority evidence remained implicit and therefore vulnerable to stale or inflated status.
resolution: Added one immutable content-addressed reference-chain edge with exact source and target record refs, Caseflow and repository bindings, typed attestation or receipt evidence, deterministic verification, strict bounds, and no caller-supplied pass, approval, verification, verdict, or stage-advance field.
knownLimitations: No downstream consumer is registered until its own exact integration lands.
Endpoint-specific validators, Caseflow, receipt authorities, and external NodeProof retain their own decision authority.
NodeRoom integration and the 48-render proof remain separate consumer work.
Canonical promotion requires a separately verified human approval.
